Source: https://laravel.com/cloud/docs/abuse.md

# Report abuse

Report abuse and violations of Laravel Cloud terms of service and policies.

To report abuse, email us at [security@laravel.com](mailto:security@laravel.com).

## Our commitment

> [card] Security First
>
> Your security and safety are our top priorities. We handle every abuse report with your confidentiality and security guaranteed.

> [card] Responsible Disclosure
>
> We handle all abuse reports sensitively and follow best practices for disclosing issues responsibly.

> [card] Zero Tolerance
>
> Laravel has a zero-tolerance policy for abuse. We act immediately to protect the security of our platform.
